ai_summary: Adani Green Energy Limited (AGEL) has settled proceedings with SEBI concerning alleged violations of financial disclosure regulations (Regulation 33(1)(d)), paying INR 4,550,000 without admitting or denying guilt. The company explicitly states this settlement has no material financial impact. While the monetary impact is negligible, the occurrence of a regulatory settlement for an alleged disclosure non-compliance suggests a past procedural lapse.
